errors.text_span: 包括“操作”、“时间”、“疾病”、“医学”和“检查症状”
errors.evidence: The description lists five categories and incorrectly merges "Examination" and "Symptom" into a single category "检查症状" (Examination Symptom). The chart clearly shows six distinct categories: Operation, Time, Disease, Medicine, Examination, and Symptom.

errors.text_span: 水平轴标签按字母顺序排列。
errors.evidence: The categories on the horizontal axis are not in alphabetical order. For example, 'Operation' comes before 'Time', but 'Disease' comes after 'Time'.
The range of the vertical axis goes up to 40%, not 35%.
The major tick marks on the vertical axis are at intervals of 5% (0%, 5%, 10%, 15%, etc.), not 10% and 20%.
The bar for 'Operation' is at approximately 11%, not 'exactly 12%' as the text claims with the word '刚好'.

errors.text_span: “疾病”的柱状图占据约 10% 的比例
errors.evidence: The bar for 'Disease' is visibly above 10%, at a value of approximately 12%.

errors.text_span: “医学”的柱状图达到 35% 的比例
errors.evidence: The bar for 'Medicine' is at approximately 12%. The bar that reaches 35% corresponds to the 'Symptom' category, which the description misidentifies.

errors.text_span: “检查症状”的柱状图位于图中的中间位置，达到约 20% 的比例。
errors.evidence: This refers to the non-existent merged category '检查症状'. The value of approximately 20% (actually ~19%) belongs to the 'Examination' category, not a merged one.
The description fails to mention the label for the horizontal axis, which is '实体类型' (Entity Type).
The description omits the 'Symptom' category, which has the highest value in the chart at approximately 35%. This is a key feature of the data distribution.
